name: hosts
description: A hosts look for the whole window, after a terminal multiplexer's: a near-black terminal-first window, rounded panes beside a quiet sidebar, a mint accent, monospaced status lines. The sidebar is a hosts list: This Mac and every machine your sessions run on, each with a leading identity icon and its sessions under it, every session with its program status (working, blocked, done, error, idle) and what it is doing now, plus Add Host. Workspaces are grouped by computer. Every New Tab is a session picker (search every session on every host), each chat's Session Info gets a block card (host, session, status, folder), and the hover card reads like a status line.

files.themes/hosts.json:
// Hosts: a near-black terminal-first window, rounded panes beside a quiet
// sidebar, a mint accent, balanced gutters. Edit and save, the window repaints at once.
{
  "name": "Hosts",
  "description": "Near-black chrome, rounded panes beside a quiet sidebar, a mint accent.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Dark",
  "colors": { "background": "#0b0c0e", "foreground": "#e4e6eb", "selection": "#23272e", "cursor": "#7ee2b8", "accent": "#5fd4a4" },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",

  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "none",
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "default",
  "appearance.borders": "none",

  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#08090a",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#121418",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "quiet",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "arc",

  "appearance.density": "comfortable",
  "ui.animationSpeed": "fast",

  // Shape, not only color (Leo: "customizing the tabs/sidebars a lot deeper"): an operations console: a wide 320 pt sidebar with tall computer headers and big status dots, 8 pt corners, gooey flush tabs into the panes, the top right buttons always shown, Session Info over the terminal.
  "density": { "basedOn": "comfortable", "tokens": {"tabCornerRadius": 8, "verticalTabCornerRadius": 8, "sidebarCornerRadius": 8, "itemCornerRadius": 6, "sidebarWidth": 320, "sidebarRowHeight": 30, "sidebarHeaderHeight": 30, "sidebarStatusDot": 9, "sidebarRowGap": 2, "tabGap": 3, "browserRowHeight": 28 } },
  "appearance.cornerFlush": "flush-goo",
  "window.titlebarButtons": "always",
  "agentPane.display.sessionInfo.placement": "overlay"
}
